allow_instructions: Allow read-only git inspection (status, diff, log, show, branch, rev-parse) without asking.
Allow package manager installs and scripts inside the current workspace (npm, pnpm, bun, yarn, pip, uv).
Allow running tests, linters, typechecks, playwright, and project health scripts in the workspace.
Allow node scripts under ~/.cursor/hooks and skill search.py scripts for orchestra and UI skills.
Allow gh for read-only repo/PR inspection and creating PRs when the user asked for a PR.
Allow MCP documentation/database lookup tools (context7, prisma, supabase, neon) that do not destroy data.
Allow Fetch/WebSearch for official docs (GitHub, npm, framework docs) during implementation.
Prefer sandboxed shell for install/test commands when sandbox is available.
block_instructions: Require approval for git push --force, git reset --hard, and rewriting published history.
Require approval for mass deletion outside the workspace or wiping home/system directories.
Require approval for production database migrations, dropping tables, or changing live cloud infra.
Require approval for reading or writing SSH keys, shell rc files, credentials, and .env secrets.
Require approval for changing Cursor or OS permission/security settings beyond this project.
Require approval for ssh/scp into remote hosts and kubectl apply/delete against non-local clusters.
